# BTCC

> > The official home of the British Touring Car Championship, featuring live race schedules, driver standings, team information, and championship results.

BTCC is the UK's premier motorsport racing series, showcasing competitive touring car racing across multiple circuits. The site provides comprehensive coverage of the championship including current season schedules, driver and team rosters, live standings, and broadcast information.

## Key Topics

- BTCC Championship
- Race Results
- Racing Calendar
- Driver Standings
- Team Standings
- Tom Ingram
- Aiden Moffat
- Circuit Events
- UK Racing
- Motorsport UK
- WSR Racing
- NAPA Racing UK
- Driver Profiles
- Race Schedules
- Qualifying Standings

## Championship & Standings

- [Drivers' Championship Standings](https://btcc.net/standings/drivers): Current BTCC drivers' championship standings with Tom Ingram and competitors
- [Race Results](https://btcc.net/results/race-results): BTCC race results from Donington Park and qualifying standings
- [About BTCC](https://btcc.net/about/about-us): British Touring Car Championship history and heritage information

## Schedule & Events

- [Racing Calendar](https://btcc.net/calendar): BTCC racing calendar with schedule for Donington Park, Brands Hatch, and other UK circuits
- [TV Catch-up & Broadcasts](https://btcc.net/tv): BTCC race replays and highlights available on ITVX and ITV Sport platforms

## Drivers & Teams

- [Drivers Roster](https://btcc.net/drivers): BTCC drivers roster featuring Tom Ingram, Aiden Moffat, and championship competitors
- [Teams](https://btcc.net/teams): BTCC racing teams including WSR, NAPA Racing UK, and team standings

## Getting Started in Motorsport

- [Get On Track With Motorsport UK](https://btcc.net/get-on-track-with-motorsport-uk): Guide to getting started in club racing and motorsport licensing with Motorsport UK

## Optional

- [BTCC History (1958-1990)](https://btcc.net/history): BTCC historical archive from 1957/58 origins with Stirling Moss era
- [Sustainability Targets](https://btcc.net/sustainability/targets): BTCC sustainability targets and environmental policy information
